# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 stable release** · Released September 21, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.153.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 delivers Skia m153 with current upstream rendering correctness fixes. Linux font fallback may select a different face after this engine update; use an explicit or bundled typeface where selection must be deterministic.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback may select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, which can change selected glyphs or text metrics. Specify a family and style, or bundle the typeface, when deterministic fallback selection matters. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — The bundled renderer moves to Chrome milestone 153 and includes the current upstream correctness, buffer-upload, and bug-fix syncs. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927), [#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062), [#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

Hardens the bundled HarfBuzzSharp native build configuration without changing its managed API.
